what_unblocks_t8: (A) Multi-host launcher across all 8 hosts of the v6e-32 slice (32 chips * 32 GB = 1024 GB total HBM, where V4-Flash bf16 fits with headroom -- the Tier 3 budget tests measured 17 GB/device on a 32-device mesh)

(B) Native FP4/FP8 storage on TPU (no bf16 dequant) plus on-the-fly dequant in matmul; reduces resident weight memory 4-8x. Substantial new work (Pallas kernel or qwix-style quant rules + apply_weights_to_param_tree rework to keep (packed, scale) tuples).
(C) Per-layer host-RAM offload (708 GB host RAM fits full bf16 model). Requires per-layer state in __call__ and adds ~1 layer-transfer of latency per token.
decision: Documented in BLOCKERS.md::T8-HBM-OOM; T8 architecturally blocked on this 4-chip view of the slice. The functional core (math, decode, dequant, multi-seq, nnx port, load_weights wiring) is correct and validated on synthetic + real-shard paths.
deploy_gate_status_for_user: Tier 8 cannot pass on this 4-chip host. To exercise the deploy gate, the host loop must launch vllm-tpu across all 8 hosts of the v6e-32 slice (option A above) -- this is launcher / coordinator work, not model-code work.
